rules: Headings must use Playfair Display for a premium, authoritative feel.
Body text must use Inter for maximum readability.
Use tracking-tight on all headings above text-3xl.
Use uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] for overlines and labels.
Do not center-align paragraphs; left-align dense content.

classes.h1: font-serif text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-medium tracking-tight
classes.h2: font-serif text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-normal tracking-tight
classes.overline: font-sans text-xs font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-sky-600

layout_and_spacing.border_radius: rounded-2xl for cards, rounded-full for primary buttons

Hero.layout: Grid 1x2 (Text left, Image right). Or large background with max 50% opacity overlay.
Hero.instructions: Use 'premium_clinic_hero' image. Headline: 'Ексклузивно партньорство за водещи ортодонтски клиники'. Subhead: 'Получавайте квалифицирани, предварително консултирани пациенти. Без маркетингов шум, само реални резултати.' CTA Button ('Кандидатствайте') with data-testid='hero-apply-btn'.

HowItWorks.instructions: Cards with no border, shadow-sm, bg-white. Titles: 1. Предварителна селекция, 2. Образование, 3. Директна връзка. Use Lucide icons in sky-500.

Differentiators.layout: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) - span combinations of col-span-4 and col-span-8.
Differentiators.instructions: Use glass_dark styling for cards. Integrate 'dental_abstract_macro' image into one large card. Highlight: No agency fees, High patient intent, Premium network.

Requirements.layout: 2-column split. Left: sticky overline + heading. Right: strict checklist.
Requirements.instructions: Use 'requirements_professional' image softly blended or in a rounded-2xl container. Checklist items with 'CheckCircle2' icon.

CTA.instructions: Use 'glass_tech_background' with heavy dark overlay. Heading: 'Готови ли сте да надградите практиката си?'. Primary button with data-testid='footer-apply-btn'.

TrustPositioning.instructions: Italicized Playfair Display text: 'Изграждаме мост между информираните пациенти и специалистите, които заслужават тяхното доверие.'

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium B2B 'For Clinics' landing page in Next.js (App Router, .js files).
Configure tailwind.config.js to map font-serif to Playfair Display and font-sans to Inter.
Do NOT use typical SaaS marketing templates. Aim for a 'Law Firm' or 'Luxury Private Clinic' aesthetic.

Implement a 'Dark/Light Hybrid' section sequence: Hero (Dark bg-slate-950) -> How It Works (Light bg-slate-50) -> Differentiators (Dark bg-slate-950) -> Requirements (Light bg-white) -> CTA (Dark bg-slate-950).
Buttons: rounded-full, bg-sky-500, hover:bg-sky-600. MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-apply-btn').
Card styling: Dark mode cards use glassmorphism (bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10). Light mode cards use simple bg-white with subtle shadow and border-slate-200.
Copy MUST be in Bulgarian exactly as requested.
DO NOT use placeholder images. Use ONLY the media_urls provided in this JSON.
Ensure section paddings are extremely generous (py-24 or py-32).
